job.style: a diary entry or letter by a student

response.passage: Dear Diary, today I finally finished counting the money in my piggy bank. I have been saving for 4 months to buy a new cricket bat. My uncle, Mr. Sharma, gave me 500 rupees on my birthday in January. I also earned 200 rupees by helping my sister, Priya, with her science project. I realized that because I stopped buying expensive snacks at the school canteen every day, I was able to save this money much faster. My friend Rohan says he saves by keeping his coins in a metal box, but I prefer my ceramic piggy bank. Budgeting is hard, but seeing the total amount grow makes me feel responsible. I want to buy the bat before the inter-school tournament starts in May. If I continue to avoid those daily canteen treats, I will reach my goal easily. It is interesting how small daily choices lead to big results over time. I am learning that saving is not just about having money, but about planning for what truly matters to me.
response.summary: A student reflects on their progress in saving money for a cricket bat. By cutting down on daily canteen expenses, they have successfully increased their savings over four months.
